name: Kinda Brave Entertainment Group
summary: Kinda Brave Entertainment Group AB (Publ) functions as a video game holding company. Its core strategy centers on acquiring both game development studios and intellectual properties within Sweden. The firm is also actively cultivating its own internal studios and establishing a third-party publishing arm, dedicated to identifying and fostering promising new developers who can shape future gaming trends. Its titles are made available through major digital distribution platforms, including Steam, the PlayStation Store, Xbox Marketplace, and the Nintendo eShop. Founded in 2022, the company is headquartered in Uppsala, Sweden.
